Applied blood integration modifications: Unity URP material conversion, bilinear filtering of blood textures, terrain-conforming ground meshes using the original blood textures. The ground meshes are project-generated; the underlying art is attributed above. Arm modifications: URP Lit base-color and normal-map conversion; nonmetallic skin with constant smoothness 0.23; original metallic/roughness textures retained but not assigned; grounded orientation and 0.92 m bounding-box length. Reusable prefab in Assets/Demo/Environment/SeveredArm. No model geometry edits. No paid resources, purchases, or new software dependencies are required.

Design traceability: GDD v4 prologue scope R53/R59; Narrative v2 section III (physical evidence and blood traces); F23 environmental storytelling, F24 art direction, F27 English in-game text. The explicit user request authorizes a severed arm and visible blood at the existing trail clue. This does not approve any final-game system or change investigation state transitions.
